    "neighbour_comparison": "Three suggested neighbours were compared by all three topic-5 seats. All three seats call swarm-report-format contradicted. Its criterion 3 and Q-7 fix fence-only reading; its tolerant extraction is limited to topics; its non-goals exclude retrying other stages and replacing models; and its 72 + 6N ceiling covers topic corrections only. Q-1, Q-2 and Q-7 cross each of these (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2). Under Q-6 the fence rule would instead be kept, which is the open Q-1/Q-6 question. swarm-citation-feedback is related: Q-2 copies its PR 392 feedback pattern, but its spec excludes model substitution and ceiling changes, and its own verify and phase-6 review are still due (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4). research-free-paid is related: it owns the shared free selection and paid admission that Q-7's 'another admitted model' would read, it keeps the 39 slots and budgets unchanged, and neither change names the other (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5). The change's own record and header declare no neighbours (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7). The map records ADR 0020 Decision as a resolved neighbour key without a frozen spec.",
    "practice_comparison": "Online evidence (topics 9-11) is thin and mostly at title level. It covers repair libraries for malformed LLM JSON (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C1), a validate-repair-retry-with-feedback project and article (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2), schema-constrained structured-output offerings (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/10/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C2), and self-consistency majority voting (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C3). Against the change: Q-2's single retry carrying the exact parse or schema error matches the retry-with-feedback pattern. Q-1 and Q-6 both read wrappers tolerantly but repair nothing, unlike the repair libraries, so an invalid object inside a fence falls to the retry. Constrained generation has no counterpart in the answers. The Q-5 quorum is a two-of-three validity threshold over locator lists merged as a union, not the majority vote the literature describes (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4). No retrieved source gives retry counts, quorum thresholds, failure rates or a dated incident on tolerant reading or retry storms (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/11/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6). Whether one retry, one handover and a two-of-three quorum are adequate therefore cannot be compared with practice.",
    "supported_facts": [
      "Two readers exist in scripts/stage2_research_run.py. payload_text (finders, map merge, judge) returns the stripped answer, or the content of a fence only when that fence is the whole answer. topic_report_payload (topics, via validate_topic into validate_research_report) accepts a whole JSON object, or exactly one json or unlabelled fence. It parses only the fence content and ignores prose outside it. It refuses other fence counts, other labels, a shorter closing fence and non-object values (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "payload_text has three call sites: Run.stage_finders (validator and finder_reports), Run.map_merge and Run.validate_judge. The strict validators sit behind the extraction step and stay separate from it: validate_locator_report/_entries, merge_research_map, validate_judge with _load/_keys, and validate_research_report (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4).",
      "The reader call sites catch different exception types. stage_finders catches only ResearchMapError, stage_merge catches ResearchMapError and Stop, and judge and topics catch ResearchReportError/ResearchJudgeError. payload_text raises nothing. A shared reader therefore has to fit three different except clauses (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4).",
      "The decisions file records two incompatible reading rules on the same day. Q-1: exactly one top-level JSON object anywhere in the answer, fences and prose ignored, swarm-report-format Q-7 superseded, no ADR 0020 change. Q-6 (recorded later, commit 9f6003ea): the swarm-report-format Q-7 fence rule applies to every stage, text outside the fence is never read, an ADR 0020 amendment is required, and a replay of recorded answers must come before the build. No addendum reconciles them (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "Current tests pin the fence-only topic reader in ways a Q-1 reader would change. 'Here is the report: ' followed by a bare object must be refused. An answer holding a fenced object beside a second object in prose must be accepted, and Q-1's 'several objects are refused' rule would refuse it. Refusals of ambiguous, truncated-nested and unclosed wrappings are also pinned (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2).",
      "No test names payload_text. Finder, merge and judge answer reading is exercised only end to end with bare JSON. No test wraps those answers in a fence or in prose (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3).",
      "The one existing correction is bound to topic slots and the same seat. correction_entry files under stage 'topics' with attempt 2 and the same endpoint, model, effort and tools. Its allowance is the seat's remaining topic allowance, and it is withheld when that is spent. correction_prompt words the request as 'topic {n}' and 'the report validator'. CORRECTION_SUFFIX is the only correction key convention, and a byte-level test pins the prompt (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6).",
      "The correction prompt carries the rejected answer, the reason and any per-citation failures as neutralised, fenced data. It rebuilds the earlier prompt byte for byte when no failure rows exist (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5).",
      "Any non-ok stage record ends the run. require_ok raises Stop, and the finder, merge, sentence and judge stages call it. The single-call merge and judge also hard-stop on a validation failure, with no second call. Deadline exhaustion and cancellation produce non-ok outcomes that require_ok treats the same way (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7).",
      "merge_research_map refuses any finder dict whose length is not three ('exactly three trusted finder seats are required'). It demands the exact union of finder origins and reasons. Slot reuse requires an exact stage/topic/seat/endpoint/model/prompt-hash match. No test asserts the three-count refusal directly, and every merge test passes exactly three reports (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3).",
      "Run.run_stage is a generic batch dispatcher.       "Each paid role carries exactly one endpoint/model. research_roles builds one dict per role. model-endpoints.yaml declares one judge and one topic_author, and a missing finder_merge silently takes the judge's model. ADR 0020 point 11 pins seats with no fallback list (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4).",
      "Run.manifest_record writes budget 39 + 3N and invocation_ceiling 72 + 6N as literals. It has no per-model bare/fenced/repaired/refused counts (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7).",
      "The invocation ceiling is a recorded number only. A grep of scripts/ found no runtime check against it. The figure is restated in ADR 0020, docs/WORKFLOW.md 'The routing', the scripts/stage2_swarm.py docstring (per commit 86c0dd68), the manifest and the accounting tests (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5).",
      "ADR 0020 point 2 fixes three repository finder seats and an exact deduplicated union. Point 9, as amended on 2026-11-10, allows one correction for a topic report only, says 'No other retry is allowed', caps a run at 72 + 6N, lets a failed finder, merge or topic-author stage prevent later stages, and keeps time limits unchanged. Point 11 fixes the probe rules. At the frozen head, the 2026-11-10 change is point 9's only amendment (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5).",
      "Q-2 (point 9), Q-5 (points 2 and 9) and Q-7 (point 9) each record that a maintainer amendment of ADR 0020 must come before the build. Q-6 also records an amendment. Q-1 and Q-4 record no architecture change (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3).",
      "A dated addendum withdrew the Q-3 format probe. The Q-3 record stays under its own heading, so ADR 0020 point 11, PROBE_TEXT and the two tests that pin the fixed probe text are unchanged. probe_go already takes a text parameter, while probe_claude hard-codes PROBE_TEXT (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6).",
      "The change declares class architectural. On 2026-11-15 the class moved from bounded to feature (dbda68b4) and then to architectural (9f6003ea), because the answers amend ADR 0020. The research manifest also carries class architectural (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "docs/adr/ is reserved for human-decided writing. A pull request touching it is a decision PR under house rule 8, and pr_sync treats such paths as held. An ADR answer may be recorded only as the maintainer stated it (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7).",
      "The change folder holds only research.md and decisions.md. The change's own run 0df71f24 is incomplete: finders-0-2 timed out and finders-0-3 was invalid-report, so no merge, topic or judge call started. research-handoff counts only complete runs and fails a spec that has v2 runs but none complete. Before a spec exists, unanswered items are only reported as pending (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2).",
      "In run 0df71f24 the stored claude-haiku finder answer was a bare four-list object, refused because some entries lacked a reference — a schema fault, not a wrapper fault. In the triggering run fc0e84ae, haiku wrote prose and then a valid fence, deepseek wrote invalid JSON inside a fence (char 13598), and mimo's bare object passed (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6).",
      "The finder prompt demands 'exactly one JSON object and nothing else'. That is narrower than either candidate reading rule (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7).",
      "Earlier ADR amendments were dated additions inside the existing ADR file (ADR 0020 on 2026-11-10, and ADR 0025). docs/adr/ ends at 0025, and a handover records a committed draft of ADR 0026 for a parked change (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5).",
      "Resume adopts a stored correction only under these conditions: the first attempt is invalid-report, the correction is process-ok, its prompt hash rebuilds from the first attempt, and it passes validate_topic. That path is topic-shaped. One run per change holds the store through a per-change flock (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7).",
      "All the answers execute inside the existing 'stage2.py explore' route. The change adds no runner verb, and prepare-explore stays untouched (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1).",
      "The Q-1 context says no other stage2 path parses a model's JSON answer. stage2_research_map._entries and stage2_research_report._load nonetheless call json.loads on model text, as part of the strict validators (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "ADR 0020 names a format contract but no wrapper rule, as far as a grep of the ADR showed (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5).",
      "make verify delegates to scripts/verify_all.sh, which reads the one gate list. The blocking gates include pytest, interview-minimums, research-handoff, criterion-ledger and a guard-test-environment gate for planted faults (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7).",
      "docs/WORKFLOW.md and the research-handoff gate script, derivation and test are kit 'mechanismus' and travel to instances. The research runner falls under the scripts/ 'bestand' catch-all (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4).",
      "Neighbour swarm-report-format fixes several points: fence-only reading (Q-7 and spec criterion 3), tolerant extraction restricted to topic reports, non-goals excluding retries of other stages and model replacement, and a 72 + 6N ceiling raised for topic corrections only (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3).",
      "Neighbour swarm-citation-feedback (PR 392, the pattern Q-2 copies) is a bounded change. It excludes model substitution and ceiling changes.       "Neighbour research-free-paid centralises free selection and paid admission. It keeps the 39 slots and budgets unchanged and records no ADR change.       "The change's run record lists given_neighbours as an empty list. ADR 0020 point 1 accepts [] as valid (7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, 7c55fc9965322b68d10cf5ee6a685c29/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7).",
      "The packet history shows volatile facts around the swarm. The newest packet commit e3a807f5 adds Q-7. Model membership and skip reasons were reversed or corrected several times.       "Public tools aimed at malformed LLM JSON exist: RealAlexandreAI/json-repair (README: repair malformed LLM JSON, GPL-3.0 badge), mangiucugna/json_repair (Python), and outputguard (validate, repair and retry with feedback).       "OpenAI documents 'Structured model outputs' as an API feature, and a practitioner article contrasts structured outputs with validate-and-retry.
